1.

I heard Jesus say: Come, I give thee rest, Draw now to My heart And rest steadfastly there! I came, sorrowful, sinful, So weary and poor I was, I found rest in Jesus And joy and defence.

2.

I heard Jesus say: For nought I give Unto all the waters of life, Come hither and receive! I came and drank and live Of the clear river of grace; I have life and bliss Through Jesus’ blood.

3.

I heard Jesus say: Behold, I am the light of the world, I shall shine thee out of darkness Home to the Father’s house! I came, and now in Jesus An eternal light I have, And around my path He shines Like the clear noonday sun.
